Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Rose Tico (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), game text: “If Finn is about to be lost from same site, may place him in Used Pile instead. Once during battle, if your starship (or your other Resistance character) here is about to be 'hit' (and Rose is not 'hit'), may cause Rose to be 'hit' (and forfeit = 0) instead.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-122022.pdf Errata Sheet December 2022] (Players Committee), page 3, PDF built 19 December 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
